ns2:course.label: Human Osteology
ns2:course.description: (ANTH 356) Identification of human skeletal material and basic techniques of measurement; methods of determining age, sex, race, and stature from the human skeleton; and analysis of skeletal populations. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for both ANTH 456 and ANTH 246. Prerequisite: ANTH 102 or a course in anatomy, physiology, or introductory life sciences and consent of instructor.
